item.title: [cli/cli] GitHub CLI 2.104.0 (v2.104.0)
item.description:
## Protect private forks when deleting repositories
`gh repo delete` now warns when deleting a private or internal repository will also delete its forks. The additional confirmation is required even with `--yes`.
Non-interactive workflows and agents must explicitly accept the cascading deletion:
```shell gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks ```
## What's Changed
### ✨ Features
* Require confirmation before `gh repo delete` deletes private forks by @BagToad in #14858
### 🐛 Fixes
* fix(auth status): surface underlying rate-limit, server, and network errors in terminal output by @babakks and @Copilot in #15009 * fix(auth): skip token refresh when `gh`'s state directory is not writable by @babakks in #14845
### 📚 Docs & Chores
* Use REST to apply issue triage labels by @BagToad in #15041 * Prevent repeated Dependabot triage assessments by @BagToad in #15002 * Apply issue triage labels directly by @BagToad in #1500

item.title: [nanaism/yomiyasu] v3.1.0
item.description:
yomiyasu v3.1.0 を公開しました。 スキルのフォルダから Codex 用のプラグインの設定を外したバージョンです。 Codex にスキルのフォルダを写して入れている方は、スキルの名前が `yomiyasu:yomiyasu` から `yomiyasu` に変わります。更新したあとに書き換える所は、下の「Codex で使っている方へ」にあります。 名前が変わるので、パッチではなくマイナーバージョンにしています。 推敲の手順（SKILL.md と references）は、SKILL.md のバージョンの行を除いて v3.0.1 から変えていません。 lint、diff、check、フックの出力も、JSON の `tool_version` と `--version` が示すバージョンを除いて v3.0.1 と同じです。
## 背景と課題
パッケージマネージャーの apm で yomiyasu をプロジェクトに入れようとすると失敗する、という報告をいただきました（Hol1kgmg さんの issue #61）。
apm は、依存先を `nanaism/yomiyasu/skills/yomiyasu` のようにフォルダまで書くと、そのフォルダの中身だけを見て種類を決めます。 apm 0.35.0 からは、フォルダに `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` があると、SKILL.md より先にこれを見て「Codex のプラグイン」と決めるようになりました。 apm は Codex のプラグインをユーザー単位でしか入れない決まりにしているので、プロジェクト単位の `apm install` が止まります。
このファイルは v2.0.2 で置いたもので、Codex でのスキルの名前を `yomiyasu:yomiyasu` にするための、名前だけの設定です。 yomiyasu はこれまで、スキルの名前を「バージョンを上げても変えないもの」として扱ってきました。 名前を保つかぎり、スキルのフォルダは「スキルでもプラグインでもあるもの」のまま残ります。
## v3.1.0 で変わったこと
スキルのフォルダから `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` を外しました。 スキルのフォルダは、プラグインの設定を持たない、ふつうのス

item.title: [pnpm/pnpm] pnpm 12.20 (v12.20.0)
item.description:
pnpm 12.20.0 records the specifiers of local directory dependencies in the experimental v13 lockfile and fixes several `nodeLinker: hoisted`, peer dependency, and `overrides` bugs. The bundled `node-gyp` no longer ships the undici version that security scanners flag. Remote resolution and shared build caches no longer work with pnpr 0.1.0-alpha.19 or older.
### Minor Changes
- With `lockfile.format: v13`, `pnpm install` records the dependency specifiers of local directory packages. Frozen installs reject changed specifiers even when the locked versions still satisfy them.
### Patch Changes
#### Upgrading and security
- Remote resolution, shared build caches, and release notes no longer work with pnpr 0.1.0-alpha.19 or older. pnpm now reads the capabilities a pnpr server advertises under `pnpr.protocols`. Installs fail when the server does not confirm the requested resolution and verification policies.

### `addCommandFields` for Collection & IndexView APIs > [!WARNING] > The `addCommandFields` option is intended for internal use only. It may be changed or removed without notice at any time.
Allows adding arbitrary fields to Collection and IndexView commands.
### `collectionUUID` for Client.BulkWrite > [!WARNING] > The `collectionUUID` option is intended for internal use only. It may be changed or removed without notice at any time.
Allows specifying a `collectionUUID` for bulk write requests.

item.title: [microsoft/playwright] v1.65.0
item.description:
## 🥟 Run tests with Bun
The test runner now runs under Bun. Bun transpiles your TypeScript test files itself, so Playwright does not use Babel or its compilation cache. Pass the `--bun` flag, because without it `bunx playwright test` runs on Node.js:
```bash bunx --bun playwright test ```
Our CI runs the test runner tests under Bun 1.4.3 on Linux. Some features work differently under Bun:
- There is no watch mode. UI mode does not run tests again when files change, and `--only-changed` does not follow imports. - Bun loads modules itself, so `--tsconfig` and the JSX options in `tsconfig.json` have no effect, and custom ESM loaders are not supported. - Stack traces do not include async frames, and API names do not include the class name: `click` instead of `locator.click`. This changes some step locations, step titles and error messages. - Console output of a test does not get into the trace and UI mode.

item.description:
## What's Changed
- Nanocoder's ACP agent now honours the `mcpServers` an editor sends on `session/new`, `session/load` and `session/resume`. Stdio and HTTP servers are connected for that session only, so their tools exist in that session (and in subagents it starts) and in no other, and your own MCP configuration is never read or changed. Loading or resuming a session replaces its previous servers, and closing it, or deleting it, disconnects them. A server that fails to connect, or uses SSE, is logged and skipped and the request still succeeds. `initialize` now reports `mcpCapabilities` (`http`). A tool whose name an existing tool already has is skipped, and these tools follow the usual approval rules. item.title: [anomalyco/opentui] Release v0.8.0 (v0.8.0)
item.description:
Most of 0.8.0 makes each frame cheaper. In 0.7.0, every frame cleared and repainted the whole screen and compared every row with the terminal, even when only a spinner had moved. Now an unchanged frame paints nothing, and a frame with a small change repaints only the rows around it. In OpenCode, a frame with a spinner or a streamed line does about a twentieth of the cell operations it did.
ScrollBox now scrolls and follows new content in native code. Animations share one clock: before, an app with several animations could draw twice as many frames as the animations needed.
The native input parser is still opt-in. It now keeps a mouse wheel report that a slow link splits, which the default parser can type into the focused input as text. To try it, set `OTUI_NATIVE_INPUT_PARSER=1`, or pass `experimental_nativeInput: true` to the renderer.
